# Elementum 3D

> Free interactive 3D periodic table of all 118 confirmed chemical elements, for students, teachers, enthusiasts and researchers.

Elementum 3D shows each element with its atomic number, symbol, name, standard atomic mass, category, group, period, block, electron shells and a Bohr model. The page also contains a plain-text FAQ and a full data table of all 118 elements.

Page: https://rabin.ruhrbin.site/Science/Chemistry/periodic-table/

## Key facts
- 118 elements, atomic numbers 1 (hydrogen) to 118 (oganesson)
- Layouts: table, sphere, helix, rings
- Colour modes: category, s/p/d/f block, stability
- Every element has a link such as #Fe (iron)
- Atomic masses follow IUPAC abridged standard atomic weights; bracketed values are the mass number of the longest-lived isotope
